dissection_steps.position: Anterior-most mouthpiece, hinged to the ventral margin of the clypeus
dissection_steps.function: Acts as an upper lip that holds grass blades vertically in the median notch and prevents food from escaping anteriorly while the mandibles chew.
dissection_steps.dissection_instruction: Grip the ventral margin of the labrum with fine forceps and lift anteriorly/upward to detach it along the clypeolabral suture.

dissection_steps.position: Paired lateral jaws immediately posterior to the labrum
dissection_steps.function: Heavily sclerotized, asymmetric jaws that move transversely (side-to-side) to shear leaf tissue with sharp distal incisors and crush tough plant fibers with proximal molars.
dissection_steps.dissection_instruction: After removing the labrum, grip one mandible firmly near its base with sturdy forceps and rock it laterally outward to break the dicondylic hinge and strong adductor muscle.

dissection_steps.position: Paired composite appendages immediately posterior to the mandibles
dissection_steps.function: Manipulates and holds food particles against the mandibles using the toothed lacinia and hooded galea, while the 5-segmented maxillary palps taste and inspect food via chemoreceptors.
dissection_steps.dissection_instruction: Reach behind the mandibular sockets to grasp the basal cardo/stipes of each maxilla so the lacinia, galea, and 5-segmented maxillary palp come off intact as a single unit.

dissection_steps.position: Central preoral cavity between the maxillae, dorsal to the labium
dissection_steps.function: Fleshy tongue-like organ that mixes chewed plant material with salivary enzymes discharged at its base and helps guide the food bolus into the pharynx.
dissection_steps.dissection_instruction: Gently pinch the base of the fleshy central lobe with forceps and pull forward from the floor of the preoral cavity.

dissection_steps.position: Posterior-most mouthpiece forming the back wall/floor of the preoral cavity
dissection_steps.function: Derived from fused ancestral second maxillae; encloses the preoral cavity posteriorly and uses its bilobed ligula (paraglossae + glossae) and 3-segmented labial palps for sensory testing and guiding food.
dissection_steps.dissection_instruction: Grasp the basal submentum/mentum near the neck membrane and peel the entire labium (with both 3-segmented labial palps attached) posteriorly off the head capsule.
